LightningComponentBundle.description: Shows the public Amazon seller profile (ratings, feedback, business details) for the seller URL or Seller ID stored on the record.

property.name: sellerField
property.label: Seller Field
property.description: Field holding the Amazon seller page URL (https://www.amazon.com/sp?seller=...), storefront URL, or Seller ID.

property.name: fieldPath
property.label: Related Field Path (optional)
property.description: Overrides the field above to read a related record's field, e.g. Store__c.Seller_ID__c.
